entries.title: SafeTrase source ingestion and source-to-app integration
entries.summary: During his SafeTrase work, Dexter developed a TypeScript source platform that collects official public-health material, preserves immutable evidence and produces a versioned app-facing feed. It distinguishes new, unchanged, inaccessible and explicitly withdrawn material. Stable identities and revisions make repeat processing safe. The app importer validates payloads and preserves checkpoints rather than accepting partial or incompatible pages. A failed collection request is treated differently from an official withdrawal. Replay, corrections, bounded feed transport and provenance are concrete examples of reliability and data integrity across an integration boundary.
entries.limits: These are implemented engineering contributions. Hosted source-system qualification and complete notification delivery are not established. Do not claim that every national feed is live or invent active-alert totals. Do not disclose credentials, internal identifiers, raw records or infrastructure details.

This gives him experience contributing backend changes within a product team.

entries.title: KAP SuperQuiz at the THRIVE Project
entries.summary: As a THRIVE volunteer developer, Dexter worked across KAP SuperQuiz, a self-hosted assessment platform covering accounts, question authoring, quiz delivery and reporting. It uses React/TypeScript, Express and PostgreSQL/Drizzle, with Docker Compose and Nginx. Programme, Course and Module permissions distinguish learners, question creators and assessors, with cohort membership controlling learner access. Quiz recovery preserves progress through refreshes and interruptions using server-owned revisions, deadlines and account checks, plus a same-account browser copy. Submitted attempts retain original question snapshots so later edits cannot rewrite assessment history. Dexter also worked on release verification and user documentation.
entries.limits: Describe skills and contributions, not private code, learner data, question banks, account details or operating infrastructure. A dated release record supports release experience; current production uptime is not verified.

entries.title: Open-source contributions
entries.summary: Dexter has accepted contributions to SQLAdmin and LearnHouse. SQLAdmin merged his work on request-aware column formatting, nullable AJAX relationship clearing, polymorphic admin identity and static-file symlink handling. LearnHouse accepted Windows-compatible ZIP exports, an unsaved-editor-changes guard, environment-variable documentation and an analytics loading skeleton. These are targeted improvements reviewed by upstream maintainers. Additional Flagsmith flag-created webhook and Hey API parse-option response-type proposals were open when reviewed. A Meltano Singer SDK GraphQL error-handling proposal was closed without a merge.

entries.title: GspaceChat retrieval-augmented assistant
entries.summary: Dexter built an independent Python assistant for exploring selected public information from Gilmour Space’s website. It scrapes, cleans and chunks pages, builds a local ChromaDB index, retrieves passages and uses the OpenAI API to produce grounded answers with source links. Streamlit supplies the interface and index rebuild controls. It demonstrates connecting data preparation, retrieval, model integration and a usable interface.
entries.limits: An independent portfolio project, not employment at or commissioning by Gilmour Space. A scripted demo alone does not establish a live retrieval run. Grounding is an engineering approach, not an injection-proof guarantee.

entries.title: SureJan community forum
entries.summary: Dexter developed a Django/HTMX/PostgreSQL forum covering posts, comments, communities, voting and moderation. Vote updates use transactions and row locking to protect scores and prevent a second immutable vote on the same target. Ownership, moderation, authentication, pagination and vote behaviour feature in the test inventory.
entries.limits: Anti-manipulation behaviour is implemented heuristics, not verified detection accuracy. Current public uptime was not verified.
